subject.title: [Refactor] Missing Availability Schema Cache in manifest-tool-availability.ts

question: Should this performance refactor be sponsored without a profile showing validator compilation remains on a request-time hot path after existing plugin tool caching?
rationale: The source pattern is plausible, but repository policy favors moving stable facts earlier and the issue provides no evidence that a local cache addresses a measured bottleneck at the correct owner boundary.

options.title: Require profiling first
options.body: Ask for a focused benchmark or call trace, then implement the cache at the lifecycle owner shown by that evidence.

options.title: Sponsor proactive cleanup
options.body: Accept the refactor without measured impact, provided validators are prepared during manifest loading or descriptor construction rather than through a scattered request-time cache.

recommendation.title: Require profiling first
recommendation.body: Ask for a focused benchmark or call trace, then implement the cache at the lifecycle owner shown by that evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Adjacent plugin-manifest history makes this the best available owner for deciding the metadata lifecycle boundary.
